canonical_selector.rule: This is the only current-work selector. DPL-01..14, MAI-01..10 and AAI-01 are completed_verified; AAI-02 is selected_not_started only.

work_state.rule: AAI-02-attempt-001 is the sole CURRENT application checkpoint. It authorizes planning resolution only and grants no implementation branch, runtime schema, migration or provider-integration authority.

active_work.implementation_scope: Selection/planning only: resolve the provider-neutral audio source/asset/cue/soundscape schema, provenance/license/entitlement fields, deterministic identities, persistence decision and validation contract before any governed start.
active_work.integration_requirement: Consume AAI-01 completed provider/API/license evidence while preserving audio-intent/provider-reference separation, unsupported/unknown fail-closed capability states and all World/Event/Scene/Combat/gameplay owner truths.

selection_invariants: MAI-01..10 and AAI-01 are completed_verified with exact evidence preserved and no further implementation authority.
AAI-02 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority.
AAI-02 future start must re-read completed AAI-01 provider/API/license evidence and freshly verify current heads before schema decisions.
No provider/catalog is canonical and no provider is assumed to support every capability.
Audio intent, provider identity and selected provider asset/reference remain separate.
Commercial provider audio is controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit license.
Unsupported, unavailable, unknown, entitlement-denied or license-restricted capability remains explicit rather than emulated by scraping or prohibited copying.
Pocket Bard scraping/reverse engineering restrictions and Tabletop Audio SoundPad site-bound restrictions remain binding evidence.
User-owned file possession does not infer public-performance, redistribution or commercial rights.
Audio remains presentation/support state and cannot replace World/Event/Scene/Combat/gameplay truth.
Missing or disabled audio never blocks play; hidden/GM-only cues remain permission-scoped.
Migration 0022 remains unreserved until a separately demonstrated durable schema delta requires it.
No provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, production provider activation, real-money integration, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
